title: Nexo Earn Interest Product operates
description: Nexo operated a crypto interest product that allowed customers to earn yield on supported digital assets.
notes: Launch year is approximate and should be refined with archived first-party product pages.

title: Nexo announces U.S. product phase-out
description: Nexo announced that it would phase out products and services in the United States, including the Earn Interest Product for U.S. customers.
notes: U.S.-specific product phase-out, not a full global platform shutdown.

title: SEC announces Nexo Earn settlement
description: The SEC announced that Nexo agreed to stop offering and selling its Earn Interest Product to U.S. investors and pay a $45 million settlement.

title: Nexo announces return to the United States
description: Nexo announced plans to return to the U.S. market, making this a product-transition and regulatory-history record rather than a simple permanent shutdown case.
notes: Later market-return event; exact product availability and terms should be checked separately.
